dedupe_keys.name: a simulation based tephra fallout data set for statistical analysis and evacuation planning a case study for the 1707 hoei eruption of mt fuji

description: Kensuke Ishii and colleagues publish simulated tephra-fallout distributions for a Hoei-class eruption of Mount Fuji. Zenodo lists a public ZIP under CC BY 4.0 at no cost and names statistical analysis and evacuation planning as intended uses. The archive is a scenario dataset, not measurements from the 1707 event or a prediction that an eruption will occur. It can support simulated disruption to roads, power assets, water systems and evacuation routes under volcanic ash. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Fuji tephra release. A limitation is that the landing page does not state map format, spatial resolution, number of simulations or weather and eruption assumptions. The companion paper was listed as under review with no DOI at the time of the deposit; its final status was not checked. No ZIP was downloaded, and fallout depth or probability fields were not inspected.
